meta.description: Custom online storefront, product catalog, Mobile Money/Card checkout, and mobile shopping app development proposal.

hero.headline: Custom online storefronts and shopping apps engineered to sell.
hero.subheading: From fast product browsing to mobile money and card checkout, built to give retail brands complete ownership of their sales and customer data.

sections.heading: The direct-to-consumer advantage
sections.subheading: Transition from manual Instagram DM orders to an automated 24/7 sales engine.
sections.introSuffix: thank you for considering Web-App. We propose building a bespoke, high-speed online shopping platform that reflects your brand prestige, automates inventory tracking, and allows customers to buy seamlessly in seconds.

outcomes.title: Zero Manual Order Friction
outcomes.body: Replace back-and-forth WhatsApp inquiries with instant automated cart, checkout, and payments.

outcomes.title: Mobile Money & Card Checkout
outcomes.body: Accept MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money, Visa, and Mastercard with instant payment verification.

outcomes.title: Automated Stock & Delivery Sync
outcomes.body: Real-time inventory deduction, courier dispatch labels, and automated customer tracking SMS.

sections.heading: Start with a complimentary store audit
sections.subheading: Identify conversion bottlenecks and payment drop-offs before investing.

cards.title: E-Commerce Checkout & Speed Audit
cards.body: A thorough review of your current checkout flow, mobile shopping responsiveness, and product page conversions.
items: Mobile speed test across 3G/4G network conditions
Checkout friction points and abandoned cart assessment
Top 3 suggestions to double mobile payment conversion rates
15-minute review call

cards.title: Interactive Product Page Concept
cards.body: A custom-designed prototype of one of your signature products featuring image gallery, variant selectors, and mobile checkout.
items: Bespoke product page mockup using your brand assets
Size, color, and quantity selector demonstration
1-click Mobile Money checkout preview
No commitment to full store development

sections.footer: Complimentary audits are provided to active merchants and retail brands. They exclude ad spend, domain purchase, and hosting server costs.

sections.heading: Choose your e-commerce platform package
sections.subheading: Scalable architecture designed to handle high-traffic flash sales and thousands of catalog SKUs.

tiers.title: Starter Boutique Store
tiers.desc: Perfect for emerging fashion boutiques, beauty brands, and specialty retail shops launching their first online store.
items: Custom-designed mobile-first storefront (Home, Shop, Product, About, Contact, FAQ)
Product catalog setup for up to 50 initial items with variations (size, color)
Integrated Paystack / Flutterwave gateway (MoMo + Cards)
Customer shopping cart, wish list, and guest checkout
Basic shipping rate calculator by city / region
Order notification emails & WhatsApp customer confirmation
Store manager dashboard to manage products and view orders
14 days post-launch support & inventory training
tiers.footNote: Products can be added, edited, or put on sale by your team anytime.

tiers.title: Growth E-Commerce Platform
tiers.desc: Built for established retail brands requiring automated multi-tier shipping, discount codes, customer accounts, and marketing tracking.
items: Everything in Starter Boutique Store
Expanded initial catalog upload up to 250 products
Customer account portal with saved addresses and order tracking
Coupon codes, flash sale banners, and buy-one-get-one promotions
Abandoned cart recovery emails (recaptures lost sales)
Advanced courier delivery integration (e.g. Swift, Yango, or custom zone pricing)
Facebook / Instagram Pixel & TikTok Shop catalog synchronization
Low-stock email warnings and backorder management
30 days post-launch support and full staff video walkthrough

enterprise.heading: Wholesale B2B or multi-vendor marketplace?
enterprise.body: We engineer enterprise platforms with tiered bulk pricing, vendor commission splits, customer credit limits, and custom ERP synchronization.

sections.heading: Optional mobile app & loyalty extensions
sections.subheading: Put your store directly into your customers' pockets on their home screens.

tiers.title: iOS & Android Shopping App
tiers.desc: A dedicated mobile shopping app on App Store and Google Play that drives 3x higher retention through push notifications.
items: Native Android & iOS customer shopping application
Push notifications for new collection drops and restock alerts
1-tap express biometric checkout (Face ID / Fingerprint)
App-exclusive discount vouchers and customer VIP tiers
Published under your official brand developer account

tiers.title: Physical POS & Inventory Sync
tiers.desc: Synchronize online website sales with your physical retail shop to prevent selling items already bought in-store.
items: Real-time stock synchronization between physical shop and website
Barcode scanner support for fast checkout at counter
Combined sales analytics reporting (in-store vs online)

sections.smallNote: Payment gateway processing fees (1.95% standard Paystack rate) are deducted by the processor per transaction. Domain and hosting accounts are owned by the client.

sections.heading: E-Commerce package comparison
sections.subheading: Compare features across both store development packages.
rows: Product catalog with color & size variants
Instagram & Facebook Shop product catalog sync
Branded iOS & Android customer mobile app
Physical retail store POS stock synchronization
sections.footer: All packages provide full store ownership with zero recurring developer fees on your product sales.

sections.heading: Optional growth services for e-commerce
sections.subheading: Drive targeted traffic and increase average order values.

items.title: Product Studio Photography
items.body: Clean white-background and lifestyle photos of your apparel, accessories, or products optimized for fast web loading.

items.title: Meta & TikTok Ads Campaign Setup
items.body: High-converting paid social ad campaigns focused on direct purchases and dynamic product retargeting.

items.title: E-Commerce Search Engine Optimization
items.body: Rank your category pages on Google for keywords like 'buy perfumes online Ghana' or 'designer shoes Accra'.

items.title: Email & WhatsApp Marketing Flows
items.body: Automated welcome series, post-purchase thank-you messages, and VIP customer birthday discounts.

sections.footer: Marketing campaigns can be scheduled to coincide with product launches or peak shopping seasons (Black Friday, Christmas).

sections.heading: Project process & launch sequence
sections.subheading: A proven 4-stage launch system from catalog ingestion to first checkout.

steps.title: 1. Inventory & Branding
steps.body: Gather product photos, descriptions, pricing, variations, and payment gateway credentials.

steps.title: 2. Store Build
steps.body: Develop custom storefront design, configure cart, payment gateways, and shipping zones.

steps.title: 3. Checkout Testing
steps.body: Execute live test transactions via Mobile Money and Cards to verify settlement and order alerts.

steps.title: 4. Go-Live & Handover
steps.body: Connect your custom domain, train your fulfillment team, and launch to customers.

sections.heading: Commercial terms & store ownership
sections.subheading: Transparent milestones and zero ongoing revenue shares.

terms.title: Milestone payments
terms.body: 50% upfront to begin development, 30% upon approval of storefront catalog design, and 20% prior to final domain live connection.

terms.title: 100% Revenue ownership
terms.body: All sales revenue goes straight into your merchant bank or mobile money account. Web-App takes zero commissions on your sales.

terms.title: Product catalog supply
terms.body: Client provides accurate product descriptions, high-resolution imagery, stock quantities, and return/refund policies.

terms.title: Post-launch warranty
terms.body: Includes 30 days of free bug and technical support to ensure seamless order processing and checkout stability.

sections.calloutBody: Prices are one-time project fees for the agreed deliverables. Third-party transaction gateway fees (e.g. Paystack 1.95%) are deducted automatically by the payment provider.

sections.subheading: Let's build a shopping experience your customers will love buying from repeatedly.
